error_signature: RedisConnectionPoolTimeout: Jedis socket connection leak under unclosed subscriber pipes
error_message: redis.clients.jedis.exceptions.JedisConnectionException: Could not get a resource from the pool; activeConnections=64, idleConnections=0, maxTotal=64. Caused by: java.net.SocketTimeoutException: Read timed out reading from socket.
stack_trace_snippet:
redis.clients.jedis.exceptions.JedisConnectionException: Could not get a resource from the pool
    at redis.clients.jedis.util.Pool.getResource(Pool.java:84)
    at redis.clients.jedis.JedisSentinelPool.getResource(JedisSentinelPool.java:232)
    at com.fintech.auth.session.RedisTokenSessionStore.verifySession(RedisTokenSessionStore.java:118)
    at com.fintech.auth.controller.TokenVerificationController.validate(TokenVerificationController.java:54)
Caused by: java.net.SocketTimeoutException: Read timed out reading from socket
    at java.base/java.net.SocketInputStream.read(SocketInputStream.java:185)
root_cause: Jedis Redis connection pool exhaustion caused by unclosed socket resources. In RedisTokenSessionStore.java, when downstream read timeouts occurred during burst traffic, the connection was orphaned instead of being returned to the pool because the exception handler bypassed jedis.close(). Active connections reached the pool ceiling of 64, causing all subsequent session validations to freeze and time out.
fix_applied: 1) Refactored session store to use Java try-with-resources on JedisSentinelPool; 2) Configured JedisPoolConfig with maxTotal=128, maxIdle=64, minIdle=16, testOnBorrow=true, and testWhileIdle=true; 3) Set timeBetweenEvictionRunsMillis=30000 to proactively reap leaked sockets. Deployed hotfix PR #512.

error_signature: PgDeadlockException: Idempotency keys row lock conflict during checkout retry storm
error_message: org.postgresql.util.PSQLException: ERROR: deadlock detected. Detail: Process 28911 waits for ExclusiveLock on tuple (482, 19) of relation 'payment_idempotency_keys'; blocked by process 28919. Process 28919 waits for ShareLock on transaction 948123; blocked by process 28911.
stack_trace_snippet:
org.postgresql.util.PSQLException: ERROR: deadlock detected
    at org.postgresql.core.v3.QueryExecutorImpl.receiveErrorResponse(QueryExecutorImpl.java:2553)
    at org.postgresql.core.v3.QueryExecutorImpl.processResults(QueryExecutorImpl.java:2285)
    at com.fintech.checkout.idempotency.IdempotencyManager.acquireLock(IdempotencyManager.java:94)
    at com.fintech.checkout.service.CheckoutOrchestrator.processPayment(CheckoutOrchestrator.java:142)
root_cause: Concurrent checkout retries for the same cart during payment gateway latency surges resulted in cross-transaction deadlocks in PostgreSQL. The service was using raw 'SELECT FOR UPDATE' on the 'payment_idempotency_keys' table inside an open long-running database transaction while waiting on external payment gateway responses.
fix_applied: Decoupled idempotency reservation from relational DB row locks: 1) Implemented distributed Redis redlock with 250ms acquisition timeout and jittered exponential backoff for idempotency key leasing; 2) PostgreSQL record is inserted only once with ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING after distributed lease is acquired; 3) Reduced DB transaction boundary to exclude external HTTP gateway calls (PR #1428).

    at io.lettuce.core.ExceptionFactory.createTimeoutException(ExceptionFactory.java:51)
    at com.fintech.auth.ratelimit.SlidingWindowLimiter.isAllowed(SlidingWindowLimiter.java:78)
root_cause: Sliding window rate-limiter Lua script performed O(N) ZREMRANGEBYSCORE operations on a single hot Redis key representing an anonymous IP during a credential stuffing attack, blocking the Redis single thread for 400ms.
fix_applied: Replaced O(N) sorted set sliding window with O(1) sliding log bucketing in Redis with fixed 1-second slices and TTL expiry (PR #601).

error_signature: TlsCipherSuiteDeprecation: Outbound PCI vault proxy rejected by legacy bank partner
error_message: javax.net.ssl.SSLHandshakeException: Received fatal alert: handshake_failure (no shared cipher suites)
stack_trace_snippet:
javax.net.ssl.SSLHandshakeException: Received fatal alert: handshake_failure
    at java.base/sun.security.ssl.Alert.createSSLException(Alert.java:131)
    at com.fintech.vault.proxy.BankNetworkProxy.forward(BankNetworkProxy.java:88)
root_cause: Upstream bank core processor legacy server only supported CBC cipher suites (TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_256_CBC_SHA). Our internal JVM hardening removed CBC suites in compliance with PCI-DSS 4.0, breaking the proxy link.
fix_applied: Established dedicated mTLS egress proxy container for the legacy partner with isolated, hardened perimeter network interface allowing the necessary cipher negotiation with client certificates (PR #635).

error_signature: DynamoDbHotPartitionThrottling: Card fingerprint velocity check throttled by DynamoDB ProvisionedThroughputExceeded
error_message: software.amazon.awssdk.services.dynamodb.model.ProvisionedThroughputExceededException: The level of configured provisioned throughput for the table was exceeded
stack_trace_snippet:
software.amazon.awssdk.services.dynamodb.model.ProvisionedThroughputExceededException
    at software.amazon.awssdk.services.dynamodb.internal.DynamoDbResponseHandler.handle(DynamoDbResponseHandler.java:45)
    at com.fintech.fraud.velocity.DynamoVelocityStore.recordCardAttempt(DynamoVelocityStore.java:82)
root_cause: Fraud ring tested thousands of stolen cards with the same BIN and issuer prefix, concentrating all writes onto a single DynamoDB physical partition hash key.
fix_applied: Applied random salt suffix (0-19) to DynamoDB partition key `card_bin_prefix#salt` to disperse writes across 20 physical partitions, and enabled on-demand capacity mode (PR #1102).

error_signature: ModelInferenceLatencySpike: XGBoost fraud scoring model latency breach over 800ms SLA
error_message: com.fintech.fraud.rules.RuleTimeoutException: Fraud scoring pipeline timed out after 850ms (threshold: 300ms)
stack_trace_snippet:
com.fintech.fraud.rules.RuleTimeoutException: Fraud scoring pipeline timed out
    at com.fintech.fraud.rules.ScoringPipeline.score(ScoringPipeline.java:94)
    at com.fintech.fraud.controller.RiskEvaluationController.evaluate(RiskEvaluationController.java:52)
root_cause: New XGBoost 500-tree model deployment had thread contention on OpenMP multi-threading inside Python ONNX runtime container with CPU throttling on Kubernetes limit.
fix_applied: Set `OMP_NUM_THREADS=2` in container environment; quantized model with TensorRT INT8; scaled Kubernetes pods from 10 to 25 instances with HPA target of 60% CPU (PR #1145).

error_signature: KafkaConsumerRebalanceStorm: Group rebalance storm on device-signals topic
error_message: org.apache.kafka.clients.consumer.CommitFailedException: Commit cannot be completed since the group has already rebalanced and assigned the partitions to another member
stack_trace_snippet:
org.apache.kafka.clients.consumer.CommitFailedException: Commit cannot be completed
    at org.apache.kafka.clients.consumer.internals.ConsumerCoordinator.sendOffsetCommitRequest(ConsumerCoordinator.java:1120)
    at com.fintech.fraud.device.DeviceSignalConsumer.pollAndProcess(DeviceSignalConsumer.java:76)
root_cause: Long-running reverse-IP geolocation lookups blocked consumer poll loop for longer than `max.poll.interval.ms` (300000ms), causing consumer group coordinator to constantly evict workers and rebalance.
fix_applied: Offloaded MaxMind GeoIP lookups to an asynchronous worker pool with local caching; increased `max.poll.interval.ms` to 600000ms; reduced `max.poll.records` to 100 (PR #1188).

error_signature: IpReputationApiDnsFailure: MaxMind GeoIP and Spamhaus DNSBL resolution failure
error_message: java.net.UnknownHostException: 122.1.0.198.zen.spamhaus.org: Name or service not known

    at com.fintech.fraud.enrichment.SpamhausDnsClient.checkIp(SpamhausDnsClient.java:64)
root_cause: Internal CoreDNS cluster rate-limited outbound UDP DNS queries to public Spamhaus resolver after an unthrottled burst of 10,000 IP evaluations per second.
fix_applied: Subscribed to commercial Spamhaus BGP data feed with local Redis key-value cache; removed real-time UDP DNSBL lookups from synchronous payment evaluation path (PR #1220).

error_signature: AerospikeClusterTimeout: Aerospike key read timeout on user transaction history
error_message: com.aerospike.client.AerospikeException$Timeout: Client timeout: 50 ms. Node BB9020011425126: socket timeout

root_cause: SSD NVMe disk degradation on Aerospike node BB902 caused write latency spikes, stalling read queues during payment authorization.
fix_applied: Isolated degrading node from Aerospike cluster; adjusted client policy read timeout to 150ms with 1 retry on replica; replaced failed NVMe drive (PR #1265).

error_signature: RegExCatastrophicBacktracking: Fraud rule evaluation hung on email pattern regex
error_message: java.lang.ThreadDeath: Thread killed by Watchdog timer after 15000ms stuck in java.util.regex.Pattern

    at java.base/java.util.regex.Pattern$GroupCurly.match(Pattern.java:4645)

root_cause: A newly added custom risk rule checked disposable email domains using a vulnerable regex `^([a-zA-Z0-9_\-\.]+)@([a-zA-Z0-9_\-\.]+)+$` causing exponential backtracking on malformed input strings.
fix_applied: Replaced nested regex with linear-time Google RE2J regex library and added static rule syntax linting check to CI pipeline (PR #1299).

error_signature: GeoIpMmdbFileLock: MaxMind MMDB database file lock during hot reload

fix_applied: Changed database updater script to download to a temp file and execute atomic file rename `mv temp.mmdb GeoIP2-City.mmdb` with double-buffered reader (PR #1340).

error_signature: JsonNullPointerException: Missing billing_address field on Apple Pay transactions
error_message: java.lang.NullPointerException: Cannot invoke 'com.fintech.model.Address.getPostalCode()' because the return value of 'com.fintech.model.PaymentRequest.getBillingAddress()' is null

error_signature: MtlsCertAuthorityMismatch: Client mTLS certificate rejected by Chase Paymentech endpoint
error_message: javax.net.ssl.SSLHandshakeException: Received fatal alert: unknown_ca from payments.chase.com:443

root_cause: Chase updated their mTLS intermediate trust store. Our keystore in production was still bundling the expired DigiCert Global Root CA cross-signed intermediate.
fix_applied: Updated the client keystore PKCS12 bundle with the new Chase Paymentech 2026 intermediate bundle and redeployed connector pods (PR #760).

error_signature: CurrencyExchangeRateCacheNull: Currency conversion rate cache miss on JPY checkout
error_message: com.fintech.checkout.currency.ExchangeRateNotFoundException: No exchange rate cached for pair USD -> JPY for date 2026-03-08

root_cause: European Central Bank (ECB) rate feed cron worker encountered network timeout and failed to populate the daily exchange rate cache. No fallback to previous day rate was implemented.
fix_applied: Configured fallback to last known valid exchange rate (within 48 hours) with metric alert if rate is older than 24 hours (PR #1388).

error_signature: JwtHeaderParsingFailure: Base64Url decode failure on malformed authorization bearer token
error_message: java.lang.IllegalArgumentException: Illegal base64url character: 0x20 in token header

root_cause: A third-party mobile integration sent headers with an unstripped double-space prefix: 'Bearer  ey...'. The strict decoder threw 500 Internal Server Error instead of 401 Unauthorized.
fix_applied: Sanitized Authorization header input to normalize consecutive whitespace before token extraction and return 401 on malformed base64 (PR #544).

fix_applied: Recorded permanent webhook delivery error with clear diagnostic diagnostic code `ERR_MERCHANT_SSL_HOSTNAME_MISMATCH` to merchant dashboard (PR #925).

error_signature: DuplicateCaptureIdempotencyCollision: Capture request rejected with 409 Conflict by Stripe
error_message: com.stripe.exception.InvalidRequestException: Keys for idempotent requests can only be used with the same parameters they were first used with.

error_signature: CurrencyMismatchAcquirerRejection: Acquirer rejected card authorization for unsupported settlement currency

root_cause: Routing engine dispatched Brazilian Real (BRL) transactions to US-only Chase terminal instead of global Adyen route due to missing currency capability flag in acquirer registry.

error_signature: SftpBatchUploadTimeout: SFTP settlement batch upload timed out to Wells Fargo lockbox
